workflow: one continuous painted platform per material, three registered tile exports

jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated hand-painted MATTE medieval2D platformer PLATFORM STRIP, fullcolor detailed brushwork, absolutely NOT pixel art, no gloss/glow. Reference used for MATERIAL PALETTE and PAINTING STYLE ONLY: do NOT copy its huge groundcliff, blackgradient or fullscene. True TRANSPARENT background around and BELOW floating platform. Orthographic FRONT/SIDE view, NO receding perspective. Soft light from TOP LEFT. Entire continuous ledge visible with LEFT end rounded/chipped and RIGHT end rounded/chipped. No pillars/legs toground, no background, horizon, shadow, numbers, lines, labels. Canvas ideally1536x576 (8:3wide). Final export512x192 with3adjoiningpieces128+256+128. A THICK selfcontained chunk, long horizontal perfectly FLAT WALKING TOP exactly at equivalent y40/192 (20.83% fromtop). Low grass/snow/moss may protrude up to y24 (12.5% fromtop), NOTHING higher. Solid block from y40 to irregular jagged underside ending aroundy150-180; below y185 entirelytransparent. NO floating debris. Central HALF x128..383 is designed to REPEAT HORIZONTALLY: equal material/colors/alpha profile and top/underside at both ends of centralhalf. Match cutboundary textures at25%and75%width, no big isolated unique objects crossing those boundaries. Top surface must remain straight/flat, not bowed hill. Only endquarters terminate; middlecontinuous. MATERIAL: Warm brown EARTH TURF with low golden-green GRASS and a few TINY white/red WILDFLOWERS above top, no taller than16px. Hanging thin ROOTS, crumbly soil and little stones underneath, irregular solid jagged underside. Same thickness across entire middle, exactlyoneconnectedplatform, no 3 separateobjects and no gaps. All silhouette edges clean truealpha.
